messages:
mira: Heads-up: CI flagged a p99 regression on the latest runtime merge. Canary latency up ~2x on long-seq workloads. perf-bot posted details: <link-to-ci>

devon: saw the alert. can anyone reproduce locally? failing job: runtime/canary/seq1024/throughput. ci-bot said noisy during deploy window.

kai: I can try a local run. which branch/sha are we blaming?

mira: Merge SHA: c3a9b2e5 -> landed yesterday from PR #1427 (kernel selection heuristics). ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/12345 (log excerpt in thread).

perf-bot: CI aggregate: test=seq1024-p99; baseline=78ms; current=165ms; delta +87ms; change detected in kernel-choice path.

ananya: if it's kernel-selection heuristics, maybe the new scoring picks slower matmul kernels for short batches. can we bisect to be sure?

devon: I'll start a git bisect on the merge window. quick note: local perf runs take ~15min, so expect some churn.

kai: ping me when you hit a suspect commit; I have a repro script that runs the exact RPC traces we use in canary.

devon: starting:
```
git checkout main
git bisect start
git bisect bad c3a9b2e5
git bisect good v1.17.2
./tools/perf/run_seq_bench --seq 1024 --profile
```

mira: FYI, try toggling KV_CACHE_MODE=off too. CI used a mix of cached/un-cached requests which might interact with batching.

(devon ran several steps)

devon: bisect narrowed it down to commit 8f1d4b2 (model/runtime: kernel selection rewrite). suspect line: heuristics now favor kernel B for layers with hidden=4096.

kai: can reproduce 2x p99 locally when I enable the new selector. perf top shows hotspot in kernel_B_conv wrapper. nvprof snapshot attached (summary: increased memcpy on warm paths).

ananya: interesting — kernel_B added extra pretranspose step to support fused attention on some configs. that pretranspose could be O(N^2) for long seqs if buffer reuse isn't happening.

mira: temporary mitigation: patch selector to prefer kernel_A for seq >= 512 until we fix buffer reuse. devon / kai want to land revert?

devon: will open a small revert PR reverting 8f1d4b2 and pinning kernel selector fallback. PR #1439.

kai: also adding a unit test in perf harness to run seq=1024 nightly so this doesn't slip.

perf-bot: Repro script output (devon): p99 before revert: 162ms; after patching selector -> kernel_A: 80ms. Revert PR created: https://git.redwood/PR/1439

mira: good. schedule a canary rollback and hold further deploys until we validate. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Canary rollout paused. See incident thread #456.
